title: Real product brand logos
summary: Display bundled Puma, Adidas, Nike, New Balance, Reebok and Under Armour marks beside stock status.

changes.detail: Bundle six real brand marks from Simple Icons with SVG originals, PNG app assets and source attribution.

Match names case-insensitively and ignore spaces/hyphens for bundled marks. Preserve admin HTTPS logo overrides, fall back to bundled marks on remote failure, and keep text for unknown brands. Preserve ASICS.
